nodes.title: Awakening
nodes.body:
You awaken in a dimly lit chamber, the scent of damp stone filling your nostrils. Fragments of memory swirl in your mind—a great conflict, a choice that must be made, allies waiting in the shadows. The world beyond these walls is fractured, and only you can decide which path to walk.

A single torch flickers on the wall, casting dancing shadows across ancient symbols carved into the stone. Two passages lead forward from this place.

choices.text: Gather your wits and step forward

nodes.title: First Steps
nodes.body:
The passage opens into a crossroads. To the north, you hear the distant sound of voices—perhaps allies, perhaps enemies. To the east, a faint glow suggests warmth and shelter. To the west, ancient carvings hint at forgotten knowledge.

Your first steps in this new world will set the tone for all that follows.

choices.text: Seek the warmth and shelter to the east

nodes.title: The Scholar's Rest
nodes.body:
The western passage leads to a small alcove lined with crumbling bookshelves. Dust motes dance in the light filtering through cracks in the ceiling. Among the decaying tomes, you find one that still holds together—a chronicle of the three great factions.

The text describes their origins, their philosophies, their conflicts. Knowledge that may prove invaluable in the days ahead.

choices.text: Take time to study the chronicle
Note the information and continue north

nodes.title: History of the Factions
nodes.body:
The chronicle reveals the truth behind the three factions:

The Northern Alliance believes in strength through unity—warriors bound by honor and mutual protection. They value direct action and martial prowess.

The Shadow Conclave pursues knowledge above all else. Their scholars have uncovered dangerous secrets, and their path leads through dark truths.

The Golden Circle understands that wealth is power. Their merchants and diplomats have built an empire on trade and influence.

Each path offers different tools for the challenges ahead.

choices.text: Leave the book for others who may need it

nodes.title: The Three Paths
nodes.body:
You emerge into a vast underground hall where three distinct groups have gathered. Each bears the colors of their faction, and each beckons you to join their cause.

To the left stand the warriors of the Northern Alliance, clad in blue and silver. In the center wait the scholars of the Shadow Conclave, draped in purple and black. To the right gather the merchants of the Golden Circle, adorned in gold and white.

Each faction offers a different path to power, and each demands loyalty in return.

choices.text: Approach the Northern Alliance—strength through unity
Approach the Shadow Conclave—knowledge is power
Approach the Golden Circle—wealth opens all doors

nodes.title: The Northern Alliance
nodes.body:
A tall woman in blue armor steps forward, her eyes measuring your worth. 'I am Commander Sigrid,' she says, her voice carrying across the hall. 'The Alliance has stood for centuries against those who would prey on the weak.'

She gestures to the warriors behind her. 'We ask nothing of our members save this: stand with us, fight with us, and never abandon a brother or sister in arms. Can you make that oath?'
nodes.speaker: Commander Sigrid

choices.text: I swear to stand with the Alliance
Tell me more about the Alliance's mission
I need more time to consider

nodes.title: The Alliance's Purpose
nodes.body:
Sigrid nods, respecting your caution. 'The world above is torn by war. Villages burn while the powerful play their games. The Alliance protects those who cannot protect themselves.'

She draws her blade, the steel catching the torchlight. 'We train our members in the ways of combat. We share resources equally. And when the darkness comes—and it will come—we stand together.'

'But make no mistake,' she adds, 'this is not a path for the faint of heart. We ask everything of our own.'
nodes.speaker: Commander Sigrid

choices.text: Your cause is just. I will join you.
This path is not for me

nodes.title: Oath of the Alliance
nodes.body:
Sigrid clasps your arm in the warrior's greeting. 'Then rise, sister-in-arms. From this day forward, you bear the blue and silver of the Alliance.'

The warriors around you raise their weapons in salute. You feel the weight of their expectation—and their trust. This is a bond that will be tested in the fires ahead.

'Your first task,' Sigrid says, 'is to meet Marcus. He will assess your skills and begin your training.'
nodes.speaker: Commander Sigrid

nodes.title: The Shadow Conclave
nodes.body:
A robed figure glides forward, their face hidden in the depths of their cowl. 'I am Archivist Thane,' comes a whispered voice. 'The Conclave has preserved the old knowledge since before the factions existed.'

They gesture to ancient tomes carried by their followers. 'We seek truth in all its forms—even the truths that others fear. Our members gain access to secrets that reshape the very fabric of reality. But knowledge has its price.'
nodes.speaker: Archivist Thane

choices.text: I seek the truth, whatever the cost
I need more time to consider

nodes.title: The Price of Knowledge
nodes.body:
The Archivist's hood tilts. 'A fair question. Knowledge changes those who possess it. You cannot unlearn what you discover. Some truths are... uncomfortable.'

They produce a small crystal that pulses with inner light. 'The Conclave asks only that you pursue truth above comfort, that you share what you learn, and that you never destroy knowledge—even knowledge that frightens you.'

'In return, you gain access to our libraries, our laboratories, and secrets that kings would kill to possess.'
nodes.speaker: Archivist Thane

choices.text: I accept these terms. Show me the path to truth.
Some knowledge is best left hidden

nodes.title: The Trial of Seeing
nodes.body:
The Archivist leads you to a small chamber where a mirror of obsidian stands alone. 'The Trial of Seeing reveals your true nature,' they explain. 'Gaze into the mirror and accept what you see.'

You step before the dark glass. At first, only your reflection stares back. Then the surface ripples, and you see... yourself, but different. Paths not taken. Choices not made. The weight of infinite possibility.

When you pull away, the Archivist nods. 'You did not flinch. Welcome to the Conclave.'

choices.text: Thank you for this gift of sight

nodes.title: Shadow's Embrace
nodes.body:
The Archivist drapes a purple sash across your shoulders. 'You are now of the Conclave. Our libraries are open to you, our secrets yours to pursue.'

Other robed figures emerge from the shadows, acknowledging you with silent nods. You sense the vast network of knowledge that now connects you to them.

'There is one among us you should meet,' the Archivist says. 'A warrior-scholar named Marcus. He bridges the gap between knowledge and action. He will help you apply what you learn.'
nodes.speaker: Archivist Thane

choices.text: I would like to meet this Marcus

nodes.title: The Golden Circle
nodes.body:
A well-dressed merchant approaches, golden rings glinting on every finger. 'I am Castellan Voss,' he says with a practiced smile. 'The Golden Circle has built empires on trade and mutual prosperity.'

He spreads his arms to encompass the richly-dressed followers behind him. 'We believe that wealth, properly applied, can solve any problem. Join us, and you'll never want for resources. Our network spans every corner of the realm.'
nodes.speaker: Castellan Voss

choices.text: Wealth is the foundation of power. I'm in.
What does the Circle expect in return?
I need more time to consider

nodes.title: The Golden Contract
nodes.body:
Voss chuckles warmly. 'A shrewd question! We expect loyalty, of course—but loyalty to prosperity, not to abstract ideals. Every member of the Circle contributes to our wealth and shares in its benefits.'

He produces a small pouch that jingles with coins. 'Consider this a signing bonus. The Circle invests in its members. We provide capital, connections, and opportunities. In return, you help the Circle grow.'

'Think of it as... enlightened self-interest.'
nodes.speaker: Castellan Voss

nodes.title: Partner of the Circle
nodes.body:
Voss produces an elegant contract written on fine vellum. 'Just a formality,' he assures you. 'Standard terms—mutual benefit, shared profits, and discretion in our business dealings.'

You sign your name, and Voss clasps your hand warmly. 'Welcome to the Circle! Your first hundred gold pieces have already been deposited in our vault.'

The merchants around you applaud politely. 'Now,' Voss says, 'there's someone you should meet. Marcus handles our... security concerns. He'll show you how we protect our investments.'
nodes.speaker: Castellan Voss

nodes.title: Ancient Shrine
nodes.body:
Hidden behind a crumbling wall, you discover an ancient shrine dedicated to forgotten gods. A golden amulet rests upon the altar, pulsing with a soft inner light.

The amulet whispers of sacrifice and redemption—of a path that may one day demand everything you hold dear. Do you take it, knowing the weight it may carry?

choices.text: Leave the amulet—some powers are best left alone

nodes.title: The Amulet's Whisper
nodes.body:
As your fingers close around the amulet, a vision floods your mind. You see yourself standing at a crossroads of destiny—one path leads to glory, another to sacrifice, a third to darkness.

A voice, ancient and sad, speaks in your thoughts: 'The amulet chooses its bearer. It has chosen you. When the time comes, you will know what it asks.'

The vision fades, leaving you shaken but somehow... prepared.

nodes.title: Gathering Supplies
nodes.body:
You find a small storeroom, dusty but not abandoned. Among the scattered crates and barrels, you discover a well-stocked survival kit—dried rations, a waterskin, flint and steel, and basic medical supplies.

This could mean the difference between life and death in the trials ahead.

choices.text: Leave the supplies for someone who may need them more

nodes.title: Hidden Passage
nodes.body:
As you gather the supplies, you notice something odd—one of the barrels sits slightly askew, as if moved frequently. Behind it, a narrow passage leads deeper into the mountain.

The air from the passage carries the scent of old parchment and something else... incense, perhaps? Someone has been here recently.

nodes.title: The Hermit's Chamber
nodes.body:
The passage opens into a small cave where an elderly figure sits before a dying fire. Their eyes, milky with age, turn toward you without seeing.

'Ah,' the hermit rasps, 'another lost soul stumbles upon my sanctuary. I am Eldra, once a seer, now merely a keeper of memories.'

They gesture to a cushion across from them. 'Sit, if you would hear the wisdom of one who has watched the factions rise and fall for three generations.'
nodes.speaker: Eldra the Hermit

choices.text: Sit and listen to Eldra's wisdom

nodes.title: Wisdom of Ages
nodes.body:
Eldra's voice takes on a rhythmic quality, as if reciting from ancient memory:

'The Alliance fights for honor, but honor is a chain that binds. The Conclave seeks truth, but truth is a blade that cuts both ways. The Circle pursues wealth, but wealth is a master that demands ever more.'

They pause, their blind eyes somehow finding yours. 'Choose not the faction that promises the most, but the one whose chains you can bear.'
nodes.speaker: Eldra the Hermit

nodes.title: The Seer's Warning
nodes.body:
Eldra's face grows troubled. 'The future... I see fragments only now. But this I know: Five paths lie before you—glory, sacrifice, betrayal, indifference, and death.'

Their hands tremble as they reach toward you. 'There is an artifact, an amulet in an ancient shrine not far from here. If you would walk the path of sacrifice, you must claim it. But be warned—some fates are worse than death.'
nodes.speaker: Eldra the Hermit

nodes.title: The Hidden Path
nodes.body:
Eldra describes the route to the ancient shrine with surprising precision for one who cannot see. 'Beyond the main hall, past the warriors' training ground, there is a crumbling wall. The shrine lies hidden behind it.'

They press a small token into your palm—a stone worn smooth by centuries of handling. 'Show this to the guardian spirits. They will let you pass.'

nodes.title: Meeting Marcus
nodes.body:
A grizzled warrior approaches you, his weathered face bearing the scars of countless battles. 'I am Marcus,' he says, extending a calloused hand. 'I've watched many travelers pass through these halls. Most don't survive.

'I could travel with you—my blade has kept me alive this long, and two are stronger than one. But I don't suffer fools. If you want my help, you'll have to prove you're worth the effort.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

choices.text: Welcome, Marcus. Together we'll be stronger.
What would you have me do to prove myself?
I walk alone. This path is mine to travel.

nodes.title: A Warrior's Welcome
nodes.body:
Marcus clasps your arm in the warrior's grip. 'Good instincts. Those who hesitate rarely survive out there.'

He leads you to a small training area where practice weapons line the walls. 'First lesson—always be ready. Grab a weapon and show me what you know.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: Blade Training
nodes.body:
You take up the practice sword, and Marcus nods approvingly. 'A direct choice. The sword teaches commitment—once you strike, you're committed.'

For the next hour, Marcus drills you in the fundamentals: stance, grip, footwork. By the end, your muscles ache, but you feel... capable.

'Not bad,' Marcus admits. 'You'll do. Now, let's get moving.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: Staff Training
nodes.body:
You take up the training staff, and Marcus raises an eyebrow. 'Interesting choice. The staff is a defender's weapon—it keeps threats at distance without requiring lethal force.'

For the next hour, Marcus teaches you blocks and sweeps, how to use reach to your advantage. By the end, you move with newfound confidence.

'Clever,' Marcus says. 'Not every fight needs to end in death. You might just survive this after all.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: Marcus's Challenge
nodes.body:
Marcus's eyes narrow. 'Fair enough. You want to know if I'm worth having at your back, and I want to know the same about you.'

He picks up two practice swords and tosses one to you. 'Defend yourself. I won't hold back—much.'

Without waiting for an answer, he advances, his blade already sweeping toward you.
nodes.speaker: Marcus

choices.text: Fall back and look for an opening

nodes.title: Proving Ground
nodes.body:
The exchange is brief but intense. Marcus is clearly the better fighter, but he's testing your reactions, not trying to win. After a dozen exchanges, he steps back and lowers his blade.

'You've got potential,' he admits. 'Raw, but potential nonetheless. I've seen worse allies, and you didn't panic when the blade came at you.'

He extends his hand. 'I'll travel with you. But when I give advice in battle, you follow it. Understood?'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

choices.text: Agreed. I'm glad to have you.

nodes.title: Allies United
nodes.body:
Marcus gathers his gear with practiced efficiency—a well-worn blade, a travel pack, and a weathered map of the region.

'Before we head out,' he says, 'there are places worth visiting. An old shrine that might hold useful relics. A lookout point with a view of the paths ahead. And an old exploration tunnel that might reveal hidden routes.'

He looks to you expectantly. 'Your call. Where do we go first?'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

choices.text: I want to see what lies ahead

nodes.title: Lone Path
nodes.body:
Marcus shrugs, his expression unreadable. 'Your choice. But know this—the road ahead is harder than you think. The factions make promises, but they also make demands.'

He turns to leave, then pauses. 'If you change your mind, ask around for me. Marcus of the Borderlands. But don't wait too long—I've got my own path to walk.'

With that, he disappears into the shadows of the hall.
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: The Old Watchtower
nodes.body:
You climb the worn steps of an ancient watchtower that overlooks the underground realm. From here, you can see the passages stretching in all directions—the main hall behind you, and three distinct paths leading toward the surface.

Marcus points them out: 'The northern route is fastest but most dangerous. The eastern path winds through old mines—longer, but safer. The western route... no one goes that way anymore. Something waits there.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: The Western Shadow
nodes.body:
Marcus's face grows grim. 'Years ago, a group of scholars tried to explore what lies at the end of the western route. Only one came back, and he never spoke again—just stared at nothing until he died.'

He shakes his head. 'Some say it's a guardian left by the old gods. Others claim it's a tear in reality itself. All I know is that the few who've ventured there don't come back the same. Or at all.'
nodes.speaker: Marcus

nodes.title: Surveying the Land
nodes.body:
You spend time carefully studying each route, committing the landmarks to memory. The underground realm is larger than you expected—a network of passages, chambers, and hidden spaces carved by both nature and ancient hands.

In the distance, you can see the faint glow of the surface. The exit is closer than you thought.

nodes.title: Toward the Unknown
nodes.body:
Marcus grabs your arm. 'I said carefully—not foolishly. If you want to see what's there, we observe from a distance. Nothing more.'

You creep toward the western passage. The air grows cold, and the shadows seem to deepen. At the edge of the torchlight, you see... something. A shape that doesn't quite hold still, as if reality itself is uncertain.

A whisper reaches your ears—words in a language older than memory.

nodes.title: Northern Exploration
nodes.body:
A narrow passage leads deeper into the mountain. The walls here are covered with ancient maps and diagrams, most faded beyond recognition. However, one fragment catches your eye—a detailed map of the northern territories, marked with hidden paths and secret entrances.

This could prove invaluable for navigating the dangers ahead.

choices.text: Study the map but leave it in place

nodes.title: Deeper Passages
nodes.body: Beyond the map room, the passage branches in two directions. To the left, you hear the distant sound of running water—an underground stream, perhaps. To the right, the passage climbs upward, and you can see a faint light ahead.

nodes.title: The Hidden Spring
nodes.body:
You emerge into a small cavern lit by luminescent moss. A crystal-clear spring bubbles up from the stone floor, filling a natural basin before flowing away into the darkness.

The water is cold and pure—the best you've tasted in years. As you drink, you feel refreshed, your aches and pains fading.

choices.text: Fill your waterskin from the spring

nodes.title: Whispers in the Water
nodes.body:
As you kneel by the spring, you notice something odd—the flowing water seems to form patterns, almost like writing. You focus on the shifting shapes...

For a moment, you see a vision: a great battle, flames reaching toward the sky, and at the center, a choice that will determine the fate of nations. Then the vision fades, leaving only the peaceful sound of flowing water.

nodes.title: End of Beginning
nodes.body:
As you reach the exit of the underground complex, the first rays of sunlight pierce the darkness. The world beyond stretches before you—a land torn by faction warfare, filled with danger and opportunity in equal measure.

Your faction allegiance is sealed. Your allies are chosen. The supplies you've gathered will serve you well. Act 1 concludes as you step into the light, ready to face whatever challenges await.

The real journey begins now.

choices.text: Step into the light and begin Act 2

items.name: Sacred Amulet
items.description: An ancient golden amulet that pulses with inner light. It whispers of sacrifice and redemption, hinting at a destiny that may demand the ultimate price.

items.name: Survival Kit
items.description: A well-stocked kit containing dried rations, a waterskin, flint and steel, and basic medical supplies. Essential for surviving the harsh journey ahead.

items.name: Map Fragment (North)
items.description: A fragment of an ancient map detailing hidden paths and secret entrances in the northern territories. It may reveal routes unknown to most travelers.
